scripts.translation: 快躲起來，快躲起來，對吧～！

scripts.text: They're tempting us with Jellopy! Don't be fooled!
scripts.translation: 他們拿傑勒比結晶引誘我們！別上當！

scripts.text: Ring, Ring~ What's wrong with you people..?
I.. I've got some interesting work for ya.. Would you be interested?
scripts.translation: 我...我有份有趣的工作...你有興趣嗎？

scripts.text: We.. we porings need lots and lots of brave human worriers, ring~.
scripts.translation: 我們波利需要很多很多勇敢的人類戰士，囉～。

scripts.text: Oh, and there's an entrance fee of 500 zeny, ring.
Oh, and there's an entrance fee of 500 zeny, ring.
Hey, that's life, ring. We need zeny too you know~!
scripts.translation: 唉，這就是生活，囉。我們也需要Zeny嘛～！

scripts.text: That's.. because there's been a.. slight confliction in our.. Ring Society..
scripts.translation: 那是...因為我們的...波利族群內部...發生了一點小衝突...

scripts.text: So we've got to.............have a battle to settle this problem..
scripts.translation: 所以我們得...通過一場戰鬥來解決這個問題...

scripts.text: You'll see when you get there!
Huhhhh! Hu.. Humans are so cold and cruel!!!
scripts.translation: 嗚哇！人類怎麼這麼冷酷無情！！！

scripts.text: - You are carrying too much items in order to use the Vending Machine. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品太多，無法使用自動售貨機。 -

scripts.translation: 這是一臺自動售貨機，可以用波利代幣購買商品。

scripts.translation: 終於開始出售包含初心者在內的一轉職業人物模型了！

1 of 7 diffeent kinds of figures will be selected.

scripts.translation: ：描繪強大部族聯盟的雕像。人們相信，觀賞這座雕像能增進各部族之間的關係。

scripts.translation: 咔噠~ 伴著一陣隆隆聲，物品從波利的嘴裡掉了出來。
哦，又來了一位人類戰士！

scripts.text: How come so many humans want to join our Poring War these days?
scripts.translation: 最近怎麼這麼多人類想參加波利戰爭？

scripts.text: Well, whatever, as long as I make money out of it~
scripts.translation: 算了，只要能賺到錢就好～

scripts.text: Ok, Warriors-! Hahaha How badly have I wanted to shout it out~!!
scripts.translation: 好，戰士們！哈哈哈，我早就想這麼喊了～！！

scripts.text: You, brave warrior, are you ready to join the holy battle of Angeling and Deviling?
scripts.translation: 勇敢的戰士，你準備好加入天使波利與惡魔波利的神聖戰鬥了嗎？

scripts.text: Hehehee, I feel kinda shy now.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，我現在有點不好意思了。

scripts.text: Anyway, human. Do you want to join our Poring War?
scripts.translation: 總之，人類，你想參加我們的波利戰爭嗎？

scripts.text: How do I join the war?
Let me out of here, please!
No racial discrimination! Anyone can join if they're willing to fight.
scripts.translation: 不分種族！只要願意戰鬥，誰都可以參加。

scripts.text: But the weird thing is that you humans who used to be our greatest enemies are now our participants.
scripts.translation: 奇怪的是，你們人類以前明明是我們最大的敵人，現在卻成了參賽者。

scripts.text: If you really want to fight in the war or whatever.. the Team recruiter's right there.
scripts.translation: 如果你真的想參加這場戰爭...隊伍招募員就在那邊。

scripts.text: Also, it's totally up to you which team you want to fight for~
scripts.translation: 而且，你想加入哪一隊完全由你決定～

scripts.text: It's simple. You see that Team recruiting room?
scripts.translation: 很簡單。看到那個隊伍招募室了嗎？

scripts.text: Each team is composed of 5 people. As soon as 5 members are collected, the battle starts.
scripts.translation: 每隊由5人組成。湊齊5名成員後，戰鬥就會開始。

scripts.text: You win if you kill the other team's Porings.
scripts.translation: 消滅對方隊伍的波利就算獲勝。

scripts.text: This also means that the battle needs the total of 10 members.
scripts.translation: 所以這場戰鬥總共需要10名成員。

scripts.text: When all 10 members are collected, those participants get to choose a team. Each team then should have 5 members who are in the SAME party.
scripts.translation: 湊齊10人後，參賽者就能選擇隊伍。每隊必須由同一個隊伍中的5名成員組成。

scripts.text: So, finally, half of the members joins the Angeling Team
scripts.translation: 最後，一半成員加入天使波利隊

scripts.text: and the other half joins the Deviling Team.
scripts.translation: 另一半加入惡魔波利隊。

scripts.text: If you're a member of the Angeling Team, your goal is to kill the Devilings at the other team's base and vice versa.
scripts.translation: 如果你加入天使波利隊，目標就是去對方基地消滅惡魔波利，反之亦然。

scripts.text: Each team should try killing both Porings in the other team's base. After killing one Poring, you have a limited time to kill the other Poring. Otherwise, the one you killed will come back alive.
scripts.translation: 每隊都要設法消滅對方基地裡的兩隻波利。打倒一隻後，必須在時限內打倒另一隻，否則先前打倒的波利會復活。

scripts.text: It's sort of like a capture the flag game but with Porings instead. Understood?
scripts.translation: 這有點像奪旗遊戲，只不過目標換成了波利。明白了嗎？

scripts.text: And you need to make sure you know who's in which party.
scripts.translation: 還有，記得確認每個人屬於哪個隊伍。

scripts.text: I'll send you back to your savepoint.

scripts.translation: 那麼，大家都加入隊伍了嗎？

scripts.text: The name of the party is... {0}, right?
I'll transfer you to the battle staging area.
scripts.translation: 我會把你們傳送到戰鬥準備區。

scripts.text: Can't you have a little more consideration?
scripts.translation: 你們能不能多替別人考慮一下？

scripts.text: You don't have much time. Decide now!
If you don't get there in time, you won't make it to the battle.
scripts.translation: 不及時趕到的話，就參加不了戰鬥了。

scripts.text: So, you are the leader. Before going to the battlefield, you should check all your members.
scripts.translation: 你是隊長吧。去戰場之前，先確認所有成員。

scripts.text: Very well. I'll be the last.
I am the last. Send me to the battlefield.
scripts.translation: 我是最後一個，送我去戰場

Right? That is the name you wish?

Hey, I don't have all day! Make your mind and register as fast as you can.
scripts.translation: 喂，我可沒那麼多時間！快決定並登記。

scripts.text: Don't forget to let all the members join the party. Only the members of a registered party can join the battle.
scripts.translation: 別忘了讓所有成員加入隊伍。只有已登記隊伍的成員才能參加戰鬥。

scripts.text: So, I'll register your party name as - {0} -.

scripts.text: I'll send you to the battlefield as soon as I confirm your party.
scripts.translation: 確認隊伍後，我就送你們去戰場。

scripts.text: The clock is ticking. Make up your mind and register as soon as you can.
scripts.translation: 時間不等人。快決定並完成登記。

scripts.text: So, you are the leader of the party.
Haven't you finished the party registration yet?
You must stay on the one that has been registered!

If you aren't a registered member of the party, you can't join the battle.

scripts.translation: 我會再次確認；隊伍名稱登記完成後，就送你去戰場。

scripts.translation: 多虧了你，我們的獲勝機會增加了。

scripts.translation: 啊，我知道了！你是惡魔波利那邊的人？！

I' ts a shame the battle was tied...
scripts.translation: 真可惜，戰鬥打成平手了...

scripts.translation: 所有戰鬥徽章都已裝入。

scripts.text: There is a device to equip the War Badges.
scripts.translation: 這裡有一臺可以裝備戰爭徽章的裝置。

scripts.text: I can see the empty slots to equip the Badges.
scripts.translation: 我能看到可以裝備徽章的空位。
所有戰爭徽章均已裝備。

scripts.text: No need to equip any more.
^4d4dff - War Badge missing. You can obtain a War badge by killing members of the other team. - ^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff - 缺少戰鬥徽章。你可以通過擊敗對方隊伍的成員來獲得戰鬥徽章。 - ^000000

scripts.text: There is a device to equip a War Badge.
scripts.translation: 這裡有一臺可以裝備戰爭徽章的裝置。

scripts.text: Be carefull to not allow the enemy to take and equip your War Badge here.
scripts.translation: 小心別讓敵人搶走並裝備這裡的戰爭徽章。

scripts.text: All War Badges have been equipped.
scripts.translation: 所有戰鬥徽章都已裝入。

scripts.text: Let's teach them a lesson, ring!
scripts.translation: 我們來教訓教訓他們，囉！

scripts.text: We are no longer betting our lives for Jellopies, ring!!!
scripts.translation: 我們再也不會為了傑勒比結晶拿命下注了，囉！！！

scripts.text: Let's go! Let's fight! Let's win, win, win!!!
scripts.translation: 出發！戰鬥！勝利！勝利！勝利！！！

scripts.text: Ohhhhhh, there he is, the warrior that fought for us!!
scripts.translation: 哦哦哦，他來了，就是那個為我們而戰的戰士！！
天使波利隊～波波波，波利！

scripts.text: Wait, YOU! Aren't you on the side of the Devilings?!
scripts.translation: 等等，你不是惡魔波利那邊的嗎？！

scripts.text: Hey, human. How about fighting for us Porings on Angeling's side??!
scripts.translation: 喂，人類。要不要加入天使波利這邊，幫我們波利戰鬥？！
天使波利隊～波波波，波利！

scripts.text: - Porings are cheerfully shouting for the victory. -
scripts.translation: - 波利們正歡呼慶祝勝利。 -

scripts.text: Finally, it's time for us to teach those stupid pigs a lesson!!
scripts.translation: 終於輪到我們教訓那些蠢豬了！！

scripts.text: Those Porings with low-grades are all idiots!!
scripts.translation: 那些低等波利全都是笨蛋！！

scripts.text: Let's go! Let's fight! Fight for Triumph!!!!
Ohhhh... Here is the warrior that fought for us!!
scripts.translation: 哦哦...為我們而戰的戰士來了！！

scripts.text: This proves that humans recognize us as true monsters!!
scripts.translation: 這證明人類承認我們是真正的魔物！！

scripts.text: Wait, YOU! Aren't you on the side of the Angelings?!
scripts.translation: 等等，你不是天使波利那邊的嗎？！

scripts.text: Hey, human. Don't you wanna fight for Deviling, the noble of darkness? What do you say?!
scripts.translation: 喂，人類。想不想為黑暗貴族惡魔波利而戰？怎麼樣？！

scripts.text: The world's Best Miraculous Poring! Deviling has it all! Go, Deviling, Go-!!
scripts.translation: 世界上最強、最奇妙的波利！惡魔波利無所不能！衝啊，惡魔波利！衝啊——！！

scripts.text: - Marins are cheerfully shouting for the victory. -
scripts.translation: - 冰波利們正歡呼慶祝勝利。 -
